title: Motion vectors break for a frame when "VisualInstance3D" type is freed via "queue_free()"
body: ### Tested versions Reproducable in Godot 4.6.3, 4.7 beta 3 ### System information Win10, Vulkan (Forward+), Nvidia RTX 3080 ### Issue description When a VisualInstance3D is removed using `queue_free()`, the motion vectors of unrelated visible objects are corrupted for exactly one frame. The corruption appears as incorrect motion vectors on stable objects (e.g. camera-follow or static geometry), as if they temporarily inherit global scene/camera motion. The issue is strictly one-frame and self-recovers immediately. Issue only happens with classes derived from VisualInstance3D. It's important that the instance does not need to be in camera view for this to occur. Only `queue_free()` causes the issue. Below are other functions that do not cause the bug: ``` remove_child() RenderingServer.instance_set_visible(visual_instance_3d.get_instance(), false) RenderingServer.free_rid(visual_instance_3d) ``` This issue is related to TAA flickering and current PR's for motion blur. Will have effect on all visual effects requiring motion vectors. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115027 Below is a scene, where player is sidestepping to the right and visual instance is removed behind the camera. The black sphere and the weapon are attached to the camera node. First image - reference without camera motion. Second image - frame just before queue_free() is called, player sidestepping to right side Third image - queue_free() is called, player sidestepping to right side ### Steps to reproduce Scene setup 1 Camera3D (moving or static, both reproduce) 1 MeshInstance3D (stable reference object) 1 MeshInstance3D (camera-follow or stable object with zero expected relative velocity to camera) 1 MeshInstance3D (“test object” that will be removed) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Used engine to create scene: 4.6.3 [motion-vectors-4-6-3.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28402488/motion-vectors-4-6-3.zip) Run the project, it will visualize the motion vectors. Issue will be visible on the cube on the right side in the viewport. - One mesh instance in front of the camera is removed after 2 seconds from starting, with log message, - One mesh instance behind the camera is removed after 4 seconds from starting, with log message, - Project set to auto shut down after 8 seconds.
